# HeroUI Core UI Instructions

Foundational guidance for composing frontend pages & components (atoms → molecules → organisms → pages) while staying consistent, accessible, and performant.

## Layered Component Taxonomy
| Layer | Location Example | Purpose | Rules |
|-------|------------------|---------|-------|
| Atoms | `components/atoms/*` | Small, styleable UI primitives (typography, badges, icons) | No data fetching or business logic |
| Molecules | `components/molecules/*` | Composition of atoms (tables, cards, menu items) | Accept data via props; no side-effects |
| Organisms | `components/organisms/*` | High-level feature blocks (lists, complex panels) | May orchestrate hook calls if generic; avoid direct HTTP |
| Forms | `components/forms/*` | Entity creation/update; validation orchestration | Use grid helpers, never embed route logic |
| Pages | `pages/**` | Route-level assembly of organisms & logic | Coordinate hooks, adapters, navigation, modals |

Directional dependency: atoms ← molecules ← organisms ← pages (forms can be used by organisms or pages). Never import downward (e.g. atom importing a page).

## Naming & File Patterns
| Artifact | Pattern | Example |
|----------|--------|---------|
| Atom | `<feature>.atom.tsx` | `typography.atom.tsx` |
| Molecule | `<feature>.molecule.tsx` | `custom-table.molecule.tsx` |
| Organism | `<feature>.organism.tsx` | `map-position-list.organism.tsx` |
| Form | `<action>-<entity>.form.tsx` | `create-map.form.tsx` |
| Page | `<entity>-list.page.tsx` / `<entity>-details.page.tsx` | `role-details.page.tsx` |

## Layout Primitives

## Forms
Use `FormGrid` + `FormItem` for responsive layouts (12-column md grid). Example:
```tsx
<FormGrid columns={12}>
  <FormItem span={6}>{/* Left */}</FormItem>
  <FormItem span={6}>{/* Right */}</FormItem>
</FormGrid>
```
Rules:
1. Validation logic lives in domain schema or hook layer; form handles UX only.
2. Avoid duplicating labels; use `aria-labelledby` when necessary.
3. Keep submit buttons `type="submit"`; secondary actions `type="button"`.

## State & Data Flow
| Concern | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Data Fetching | Pages or organisms call domain hooks / adapters. Atoms & molecules never fetch. |
| Errors | Display localized message; never swallow. Use consistent classes (`text-danger`, `text-warning-*`). |
| Loading | Use `<Spinner />` inside flex center container with `aria-busy` when blocking. |
| Retry | Use a `button type="button"` with clear label `retry.action`. |
| Empty | Provide explicit empty content for lists & tables (`component.table.empty-content`). |

## Accessibility (A11y)
1. Provide `aria-live="polite"` for async state messages (not-found, loaded counts).
2. Use semantic elements first (`p`, `ul`, `section`, `nav`) before adding ARIA roles.
3. Every page needs a top-level landmark (implicit `<main>` via layout container or explicit `role="main"`).
4. Associate headings with content sections via `aria-labelledby` when heading visually hidden.
5. Interactive elements must have discernible text; icon-only actions need `aria-label`.

## Performance
1. Wrap expensive derived calculations with `useMemo` (e.g. filteredRows, pagination).
2. Extract stable callbacks with `useCallback`; dependencies minimal & explicit.
3. Avoid inline object/array creation in JSX repeatedly (move constants outside or memoize) when lists > 100 items.
4. Defer non-critical fetches until idle if page has >2 concurrent network calls (future optimization hook).
5. Never mutate props; always derive new arrays for view transforms.

## Error & Status Pattern
Use the `apps/frontend/web/hero-ui/app/src/pages/error-page` or show a toast notification for errors.

Loading state should be handled by the component to render with a LoadingAtom or show the data.

Render main content only after success path. Keep in single return tree for simplicity, or segment inside container.

## Internationalization
1. All user-visible static strings = translation keys (e.g. `page.role-details.title`).
2. When composing dynamic labels: `t('page.role-details.permissions-total', { quantity })`.
3. Never concatenate raw strings + keys; prefer ICU interpolation.

## Testing Heuristics
| Component Type | Required Tests |
|----------------|----------------|
| Atom | Snapshot or style sanity (optional) if logic present |
| Molecule | Rendering + prop-driven variations + a11y role/aria attributes |
| Table | Search filter, sort toggle, empty state, loading state |
| Page (List) | Loading → data state, empty path, error path |
| Page (Details) | Not found, error, retry, success rendering |
| Form | Validation feedback (at least one invalid + one valid submit) |

## Common Anti-Patterns (Avoid)
| Anti-Pattern | Reason | Fix |
|--------------|-------|-----|
| Inline fetch in molecule | Breaks reuse | Move fetch to page/hook |
| Duplicated loading branches | Hard to maintain | Centralize tri-state pattern |
| Direct DOM query selectors | Brittle | Use React refs or library primitives |
| Use `any` or `unknown` | Safety loss | Use generics / `unknown` narrowed |
| Hard-coded colors | Inconsistent theme | Use existing utility classes |

## Migration / Refactor Guidance
When promoting a molecule to organism (increased responsibility):
1. Move file & update exports.
2. Ensure no new downward imports (verify with dependency graph if needed).

## Example Detail Section Pattern
```tsx
<section aria-labelledby="entity-heading" className="space-y-4">
  <TypographyH2 id="entity-heading" className="sr-only">
    {t('page.entity.heading')}
  </TypographyH2>
  <div className="rounded-md border p-4 space-y-2">
    <TypographySmall className="uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground-500">
      UUID
    </TypographySmall>
    <TypographyCode>{item.uuid}</TypographyCode>
  </div>
</section>
```

## Quality Gates Checklist
- [ ] No `any` (except deliberate, documented edge wrapper)
- [ ] Accessible states (loading, error, empty, not-found) have roles/aria where needed
- [ ] Page uses header/container/footer pattern
- [ ] Translations applied to all visible copy
- [ ] Performance: heavy computations memoized
- [ ] Codacy scan performed per edited file
